findings.summary: wiki_delete still performs its inlink gate outside the single write lock, so INV-3 ('rename/delete 完成后，库内不存在由该操作新增的 broken wikilink') remains defeasible. compute_inlinks and the DELETE_BLOCKED/inlink_action decisions all run before _mutate acquires self._lock (store.py:105), and _write never re-computes inlinks. A wiki_create that lands an inlink to the target between the gate and the locked write causes the delete to proceed without blocking and without rewriting that new reference, leaving a broken wikilink newly created by the delete. This is the exact residue of the previous final review's major finding, whose text named 'wiki_rename (and wiki_delete's inlink gate)' — only wiki_rename was moved inside the lock via _check_title_exists_locked; wiki_delete was not.

WikiStore._load_index re-embeds every page on every store construction and _embed_page appends to the persisted lancedb table unconditionally, so each server start duplicates all vector rows in <data_root>/.katana/index/. The table is on-disk and gitignored, so rows grow without bound across restarts; because _rrf_fuse keys scores by page id, a vector query whose limit is filled by duplicates of the same page silently loses recall for other pages. The previous final review's minor on unconditional vector appends was fixed only for the wiki_update/wiki_edit path (via remove_page); the startup path still duplicates.

wiki_update and wiki_edit read the page (find_page_by_ref) and compute the replacement body before _mutate acquires the lock, then write the stale-derived content inside it. Two concurrent wiki_edit calls on one page both observe the same body and the second silently overwrites the first's already-committed change, producing two commits where one edit is lost. Spec §8 A8 requires concurrent mutations not to cross-contaminate; only the commit/manifest accounting is serialized, not the read-modify-write.

validate_edit_grade still omits two classes of newly-added violation required by spec §4's general rule '结果页不得比操作前新增违规项': it never re-checks provenance (an edit may delete the '# References' section or empty frontmatter sources from a page that had it) and never re-checks outlinks (an edit may remove the page's last [[...]] link, turning a compliant page into an island). Both regressions are accepted by wiki_update/wiki_edit, and no test covers either.

KeywordIndex.save/load are dead code — no caller ever persists or loads the keyword index — so contrary to spec §2 ('.katana/index/  # lancedb + keyword 索引') only the lancedb side is materialized there. The keyword side is rebuilt in memory on every start, which is also what forces the redundant re-embedding in _load_index.

Two acceptance assertions are vacuous and therefore do not verify what spec §8 demands. A5 requires 'fake embedder 下 hybrid 返回', but test_fake_embedder_hybrid asserts only `len(result["results"]) >= 0`, which holds for an empty result set; the A7 server smoke test asserts the same tautology. Neither test can fail on a search that returns nothing.
